svg.title: Facts, one inventory's view of them, and the runs that calculate the view
svg.desc: The facts are the legal entities, facilities and source streams, the activity records, the emission factors, and the units and densities. An inventory's view over those facts holds a boundary version, an assignment for each record (included and classified, excluded with a reason, or unclassified), the scope 3 declaration, and the instruments and upstream rules. Reviewing pulls the facts into the view; launching calculates the view into a numbered, immutable run with its lines and exclusions, from which the report and its exports are read. A fact corrected after a run leaves the run unchanged and is marked on the view as changed since publication.
